# Phase 00 — First Execution Runbook (READ-ONLY AUDIT)

**Do not edit Notion or original source files. Do not change `main`.** All unverified claims recorded as OPEN, not PASS.

1. Confirm target GitHub account and exact `owner/abc-platform`, installation permissions and default branch. Do not assume access from an account dashboard screenshot.
2. Record actual repo tree/branch/commit and existing docs/code; compute conflict-free change plan.
3. Inventory Notion ABC-DOC-000..018, 16 KB runtime files and canonical service/attribute IDs, with timestamps/version/status.
4. Inventory newer Library productization files; identify versions referenced but not actually retrieved (`ABC-CCR-001`, productized DOC-001/005).
5. Compare GPTs-only legacy architecture with shared-screen platform decision; avoid silent supersession.
6. Enumerate 18 cross-product and 26 AIS features, 20 PRD requirements and 19 engine roles; source and owner for each.
7. Build migration/authority matrix and risks: visual, session, tenant, safety, SOP, QA, operational transactions.
8. Define Gate-00 acceptance criteria and blockers; create reviewed ADR proposals.
9. Commit **only documentation** to isolated `docs/abc-engineering-baseline-*` branch and open a draft PR, after repo access.
10. Verify actual changed file list, commit SHA, PR link and tests; do not claim pushed when repo is inaccessible.

## Gate-00 evidence

`source_inventory`, `authority_matrix`, `migration_matrix`, `feature_coverage`, `defect_register`, `unresolved_decisions`, `review_record`. Existing docs are references; new baseline is a proposal until reviewed.
